title: The model plugin of DeepSeek-V3 checkpoints
description: A pre-norm decoder of multi-head latent attention (each position one cached latent row and one rotary key every head shares, low-rank queries, interleaved rotary pairs) with a SwiGLU MLP on its first layers and, on the rest, a mixture of experts routed by sigmoid scores within the best groups, with shared experts. A finished model plugin: its layout (layout.json) composed by the models core it extends (model-template: the serving contracts, the options) from model techniques.
